sources.entry: Taskwarrior - Taskwarrior is Free and Open Source Software that manages your TODO list from your command line. It is flexible, fast, efficient, and unobtrusive. It does its job then gets out of your way. (Source Code) MIT C++

summary.name: Taskwarrior
summary.one_liner: Taskwarrior is free, open source command-line to-do list manager that is flexible, fast, and unobtrusive.
use_cases: managing a personal to-do list from the terminal
tracking tasks without leaving the command line
pairing task management with time tracking
keeping a fast, distraction-free todo list
summary.what_it_does: The page is the project homepage for Taskwarrior, which it describes as free and open source software that manages a TODO list from the command line. It states the tool is flexible, fast, efficient, and unobtrusive. The page lists current releases: Taskwarrior 3.5.0 (stable), Taskshell 1.2.0 and 1.3.0 (develop), and Timewarrior 1.10.0 and 1.10.0-dev. It links to support, online documentation, an FAQ, and the source code. The listing notes the source code is MIT licensed and written in C++.
notable: Command-line todo manager that is described as fast, flexible, and unobtrusive
Companion projects Timewarrior (time tracking) and Taskshell listed on the same page
caveats: The page text does not name specific operating systems; platform support is unknown from this page
